sampling: nearest source frame at each analysis time, clipped tail; integer mapping CSV retained; no interpolation

arena.physical_scale_status: published nominal cohort value; no per-record independent measurement
arena.warning: Mask is a padded tracking region, not a measurement of physical walls. Bottom/top image clipping can still affect bodies. Wall distance is excluded from the36 inputs.

model_policy: Frozen v2.2 bundle retained byte-for-byte. No classifier loading, inference, fitting, threshold changes or event scoring in Days1–4.
annotation_policy: Primary and second annotator retained separately;1-based inclusive source-frame bounds; extra columns preserved with no assumed semantics. No unannotated frames certified as expert negatives.
feature_policy: Reuse pinned raw13→36 adapter at30FPS; retain missingness and source tracking warnings. Matching names/dimensions alone do not establish scientific compatibility.
